title: Bake the morning rye bread
summary: Get ready, weigh, mix on the slow speed, shape eight loaves and bake them in oven 2.

steps.title: Wash hands, put on hairnet
steps.instruction: Wash your hands for 30 seconds, then put on the hairnet, a clean apron and gloves.
steps.say: Wash your hands, then put on the hairnet, apron and gloves.

source.quote: Hairnet and gloves before you touch any dough, every single time.

steps.title: Weigh flour and sourdough
steps.instruction: Weigh 2.0 kg rye flour and 1.2 kg sourdough into the mixer bowl. Press TARE first.
steps.say: Weigh two kilos of rye flour and one point two kilos of sourdough. Press tare first.

criteria: The scale shows 2.0 kg of rye flour
The sourdough bucket is labelled with today's date

source.quote: Tare with the empty bowl, or the whole batch is wrong.

steps.title: Mix on slow speed
steps.instruction: Close the safety guard and turn the mixer lever to 1 (slow). Mix for 8 minutes.
steps.say: Close the guard and turn the lever to one, slow. Never two for rye.

criteria: The mixer lever is in position 1

source.quote: Rye on speed two overheats and goes sticky. Always one.

steps.title: Shape eight loaves
steps.instruction: Cut eight 600 g pieces, shape round loaves and set them seam side down on the tray.
steps.say: Shape eight round loaves and put them seam side down, two rows of four.

criteria: Eight loaves are on the tray
The loaves are seam side down

source.quote: Seam side down, or they split in the oven.

steps.title: Bake in oven 2
steps.instruction: Put the tray in oven 2 at 230 °C, press steam once and set the timer for 50 minutes.
steps.say: Oven two, two hundred thirty degrees. Press steam once and set the timer for fifty minutes.

source.quote: Oven two is only for rye. And set the timer, always.
